content.value_statement: Python teams need consistent pytest workflows for unit tests, FastAPI tests, fixtures, and coverage. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical commands and patterns for pytest projects that use uv.
actual_capabilities: Shows uv-based pytest commands for full suites, single files, individual tests, filters, and coverage reports.
Explains pytest discovery rules for test files, functions, classes, and methods.
Provides fixture examples for reusable setup, teardown, scopes, and shared conftest.py usage.
Demonstrates parametrized tests for repeated assertions across multiple inputs.
Documents FastAPI testing patterns for TestClient, async clients, database fixtures, dependency overrides, and authentication tests.
Includes a helper script for common pytest modes such as quick, full, coverage, failed, and watch-style filtering.
limitations: It focuses on pytest and uv, not unittest, nose, tox, or nox workflows.
It provides examples and commands, but it cannot guarantee every project has the same directory layout.
FastAPI examples use simplified test data and may need adaptation for production authentication or database layers.
Coverage guidance is basic and does not replace a full quality strategy.

use_cases.title: Add tests to a Python feature
use_cases.description: Create pytest files, fixtures, and parametrized cases for new Python code while using uv commands to run them.

use_cases.title: Validate FastAPI endpoints
use_cases.description: Set up TestClient or async httpx tests, override dependencies, and verify authentication, models, uploads, and error responses.

use_cases.title: Improve test feedback in a project
use_cases.description: Run targeted tests, debug failures, generate coverage reports, and configure pytest options in pyproject.toml.

prompt_templates.title: Run my pytest suite
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for basic test execution
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pytest-mastery to run my Python test suite with uv. Start with the standard verbose command and explain any failures in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Write tests for a module
prompt_templates.scenario: Create unit tests for existing Python code
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pytest-mastery to write pytest tests for this module. Include fixtures where helpful and show the uv command to run only the new tests.

prompt_templates.title: Test a FastAPI endpoint
prompt_templates.scenario: Add API tests with dependency overrides
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pytest-mastery to add FastAPI tests for this endpoint. Include TestClient setup, dependency overrides if needed, and assertions for success and validation errors.

prompt_templates.title: Design a complete test plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced testing strategy for a Python service
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pytest-mastery to design a pytest plan for this service. Cover fixtures, parametrization, async tests, database setup, coverage targets, and useful pytest configuration.

output_examples.input: Run only the failing tests and show a short traceback.
output_examples.output: Use uv run pytest --lf -v --tb=short. If the failure repeats, inspect the fixture setup and rerun the specific test node for faster feedback.

output_examples.input: I need tests for a FastAPI protected route.
output: Override the current-user dependency with a test user.
Call the protected route with the client.
Assert the status code and response body.
Clear dependency overrides after the test.

output_examples.input: Add coverage reporting for the src package.
output_examples.output: Install pytest-cov, then run uv run pytest --cov=src --cov-report=term --cov-report=html. Add a coverage threshold when the team agrees on a target.

best_practices: Run the smallest relevant test target first, then run the full suite before finishing work.
Keep fixtures focused on setup and teardown that multiple tests actually share.
Use parametrization when the same behavior should be checked across multiple inputs.
anti_patterns: Do not hide failing tests with broad skip or xfail markers without a clear reason.
Do not place slow integration setup in every unit test when a narrower fixture will work.
Do not treat coverage percentage as proof that important behavior is tested.

faq.question: Does this skill require uv?
faq.answer: The examples use uv commands. You can adapt the pytest patterns to other Python package managers if needed.

faq.question: Can it help write FastAPI tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes TestClient, async httpx, database fixture, dependency override, authentication, upload, WebSocket, and error response patterns.

faq.question: Can it generate coverage reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents pytest-cov commands for terminal, HTML, XML, and minimum threshold reports.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides command patterns and a local helper script. Users or their AI coding tool decide when to run them.

faq.question: Is it only for unit tests?
faq.answer: No. It covers unit-style tests, integration markers, FastAPI endpoint tests, database tests, and background task mocking.

faq.question: Can it debug failed tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists pytest options for long tracebacks, debugger entry, local variables, and rerunning previously failed tests.
